modules.description: Top-level functional modules that group related event categories.

id.description: Module identifier. The generator uses it as the first path segment in the final event type.

categories.description: Ordered categories inside the module. Categories group subcategories and must be unique within the module.

id.description: Category identifier. The generator uses it as the second path segment in the final event type.

subcategories.description: Ordered subcategories inside the category. Subcategories contain the actual event leaves.

id.description: Subcategory identifier. The generator uses it as the third path segment in the final event type.

events.description: Concrete event definitions stored under this subcategory.

id.description: Leaf event identifier. The generator appends it to module, category, and subcategory ids to build the final type.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of when the event is emitted.

action.description: Canonical action verb recorded for the event.

outcome.description: Terminal result of the action, such as succeeded or failed.

metadata_keys.description: Typed metadata fields carried with the event payload and persisted by subscribers.

change_keys.description: Typed changed fields carried with the event payload and persisted by subscribers.

name.description: Field name stored in event metadata or changes.

type.description: Go type used by the generator when emitting typed helper structs.
